title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Card Payment by the Billed Party
content:
## Capability

`pay_dnd_balance_a831ef2f` lets the billed party settle money owed on one container's Demurrage and Detention Free Time record with its own card. By running it, the customer authorises a card payment of the stated amount against the free-time record: a payment entry dated that day is written on the record carrying the customer's own payment reference, and the record's balance owed falls by the amount paid. The customer then sees the payment and what remains owing.

## Who runs it

The payment is the customer's own act. The agent unlocks this customer-side tool and passes it to the customer, and the customer themselves runs it; the agent does not make the payment.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `dnd_id` | reference number of the free-time record being paid, which the desk gives the customer from the free-time record lookup | text |
| `payment_reference` | the payment reference the customer quotes for this payment | verbatim: copied character for character as the customer states it, keeping letters, digits and punctuation, with nothing translated, normalised, summarised, added or removed |
| `amount_usd` | amount paid | US dollars, a positive figure with two decimal places |

## Return

When the payment goes through, the reply reads "Card payment <payment entry reference> of USD <amount> with reference <payment_reference> applied to record <dnd_id>; balance due now USD <balance>.", the balance being the record's remaining amount owed in US dollars to two decimals after the payment. If the reply opens with "Error:", the record reference does not exist and no payment was taken.

## Contract Q&A

**Q: May the reference be tidied up, for example by removing spaces or changing letter case?**
No. It is passed exactly as the customer quoted it.

**Q: Does the tool itself close the record?**
No. It records the payment and lowers the balance; it does not change the record's status.
